world: Arabic technical press (Bulaq rubrication): ink black, press-red rubrics, warm paper, Kufi headings

paper-deep.role: Deeper paper: hover rows, footer and notes

rubric.role: Press red: links, active states, counters

rubric-wash.role: Red wash: blocked and active fills

jade.role: Jade: done state and continue card border

jade-wash.role: Jade wash: translated fills and continue card

font.ui: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif

components.name: Press header and footer
components.notes: Sticky header with a 3px rubric rule, Kufi wordmark, inline search that navigates to /search?q=, nav with active state and theme toggle; menu collapses behind press-menu-toggle at 48rem. Footer is a 2fr/1fr grid on paper-deep.

components.name: Intro and stats
components.notes: Page opening on home and path with a 62ch lead and real counts read from content/library.json.

components.name: Continue card
components.notes: Jade-wash strip on the home page showing arabic-cs-library:last-read with a link to the saved path; label in jade.

components.name: Catalogue bar
components.notes: Filters all/translated/queued, sort select for stage/pages/title, grid-list toggle and visible count.

components.name: Book card grid
components.notes: Auto-fill min 19rem grid; card shows the LTR English title with a stage cloth dot via --book-cloth, Arabic title in display font, 3-line clamped description, pages, status badge and CTA.

components.name: Book list row
components.notes: Dense grid 2.4fr 1.6fr auto auto with a stage cloth dot on the title; author and meta are hidden at 48rem.

components.name: Status badges
components.notes: Four states: done (jade), planned (deep paper), blocked (red wash), reference (transparent rule border).

components.name: Book head
components.notes: Cover at 3/4 in --book-cloth with spine gradient, LTR mono meta and page count, title, author, 66ch lead, facts grid, action buttons and paper-deep note.

components.name: Book table of contents and aside
components.notes: Two-column body 1fr + 18rem: chapter sections with LTR mono counts and numerals, plus aside cards for same stage, path and attribution; stacked at 64rem.

components.name: Reader bar and progress
components.notes: Sticky reading bar under the header with book link, chapter, chapter counter and bookmark toggle; the 2px rubric progress line scales from the right with transform: scaleX(var(--progress)).

components.name: Reader layout and content
components.notes: Sticky 18rem aside with rubric active chapter and section, 44rem reading column in Noto Naskh Arabic at 1.16rem/2, inline toc for sections with 3-12 headings, and prev/next cards; collapses to one column at 64rem.

components.name: Path stages
components.notes: Numbered stages with a 2px ink top rule and book cards carrying a stage cloth dot, LTR English title, description, facts and dependency or replacement badges.

components.name: Search field and results
components.notes: Surface input with rule border and rubric focus-within; results are scored from two characters with Arabic diacritics stripped, title matches weighted +12, capped at 30.

components.name: Colophon cards
components.notes: Auto-fit min 17rem grid of surface cards on the about page with real numbers and licences.

components.name: Exercises box and lecture video
components.notes: Exercise box on surface with red CSS-counter circles and dash sub-items; 16:9 video frame capped at the reading width.

components.name: Buttons
components.notes: Solid ink button turning rubric on hover with a 1px lift; quiet outline variant filling ink on hover.

components.name: Utilities
components.notes: 78rem container with fluid padding, page sections, focus-revealed skip link and hidden text utility.

rules: No letter-spacing anywhere: it breaks Arabic letter joining, and Arabic text never takes letter-spacing.
Code and Latin metadata stay LTR inside RTL via direction:ltr, unicode-bidi:embed and pre text-align:left.
Reading column is capped at 44rem at 1.16rem/2 in Noto Naskh Arabic; long-form prose measures 62-70ch.
The catalogue is book cards or list rows marked by a stage cloth dot, not vertical spines; the spine shelf was dropped for practicality.
1px rules and restrained shadows; 8px radii for controls and 14px for sheets.
Four font roles: Reem Kufi display, IBM Plex Sans Arabic UI, Noto Naskh Arabic reading, IBM Plex Mono code and meta.
Light theme is the default; dark applies only when localStorage theme=dark, set before first paint.
No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no emoji marks and no cream-serif library look.
signatures: Catalogue of book cards and list rows, each marked by a stage cloth dot; no vertical spines or shelf board.
Reader marks: sticky reader bar with a 2px rubric progress line scaling from the right, sticky chapter aside, and prev/next cards.
Press masthead: 3px rubric rule, Kufi wordmark and an inline search that jumps to /search?q=.
